newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Gain by blue chips helped Dhaka stocks to close higher in a steady session which too saw correction in some high-priced scrips, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index finished 19.34 points or 0.72 percent up at 2,690.14 on a tunrover of 82.6 million taka. Of 102 traded issues, 59 rose and 43 lost.
"More and more investors are returning but they look cautious. High priced and bad shares continue to fall," said one broker.
Bangladesh Tobacco Co gained 5.10 taka to 293.30 and AMCL Pran shed 143.62 to 2,728.79. -- Newsroom +880-2-506363
